description: Six manual control voltages, each one held at its last value until a sample-and-hold trigger lets it follow its knob again

params.text: Chooses whether a row follows its knob only while both its own S&H jack and GLOBAL S&H are at or above 1V, or while either one of them is
The full-scale voltage all six knobs are measured against, 0V to 10V
At BI a knob runs from minus RANGE through zero at centre to plus RANGE; at UNI it runs from 0V fully left to RANGE fully right
Sets this row's voltage as a fraction of RANGE; the output only takes up a new position while the row is following

inputs.text: At or above 1V the rows follow their knobs; below that they are held at their last values
At or above 1V this row follows its knob; below that the row is held at its last value

outputs.text: This row's voltage, 0V to RANGE with the switch at UNI and minus RANGE to plus RANGE with it at BI

notes: with neither S&H jack patched every row follows its knob continuously, and RANGE and the BI/UNI switch take effect at once.
RANGE comes up at 1V, so until it is turned up the six knobs cover only 0V to 1V.
changing RANGE or the BI/UNI switch while a row is held does nothing to that row until it is let follow again.
the small light on a row comes on while the held output differs from where that row's knob now stands.
